title: Voice Commercial Executive
description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.

As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.

We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.

If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.

Let’s build what’s next, together.





What this role is all about

The Voice Commercial Executive drives regional growth and sales performance across North America. Acting as both a product champion and sales enabler, the role turns Voice strategy into regional execution to sustain momentum and growth. Key priorities are growing Voice UCaaS & CCaaS (service) platforms, Voice AI platforms and Voice wholesale business in NAM.


The role also manages a HQ-provided named account list, leading executive outreach, qualifying accounts, and setting up Discovery meetings to convert engagement into pipeline opportunities.


This is a role with a strong outbound focus also owns outbound prospecting, campaign execution, and opportunity creation. Success is measured by pipeline generation, customer engagement, outbound activity, revenue, and profit uplift. The role also bridges local sales teams and HQ by sharing market insights and customer feedback to support regional planning.


What you’ll do

Regional Strategy & Execution

  • Align Voice strategy with company objectives and build execution plans for NAM.
  • Drive initiatives that increase traction, improve profitability, and support new and existing customers.
  • Lead monetization priorities Voice UCaaS & CCaaS (service) platforms, Voice AI platforms and Voice wholesale.
  • Create and close opportunities through outbound prospecting and self-originated campaigns.
  • Support testing and validation of new business motions in NAM including new customer segments, new products introductions, new business models and new initiatives.

Outbound Sales & Opportunity Creation

  • Own the outbound sales cycle across NAM in close collaboration with Voice AEs and CGEs
  • Prospect, research, and target customers through multi-channel outreach to build a self-generated pipeline.
  • Execute HQ-led executive outreach campaigns, qualify named accounts, secure Discovery meetings, and progress opportunities.
  • Run campaigns focused on Voice UCaaS & CCaaS (service) platforms, Voice AI platforms and Voice wholesale from identification through close.

Sales Support & Customer Engagement

  • Support regional sales teams with training, enablement, and commercial guidance.
  • Spend time with customers to build relationships, understand needs, and identify adoption opportunities.
  • Participate in key sales cycles, leveraging Voice expertise to close deals and grow GP.
  • Provide local support to US revenue teams with same-day business decisions and joint account planning.

Product Expertise & Market Insights

  • Maintain deep knowledge of Voice products, competition, and trends across Voice UCaaS & CCaaS (service) platforms, Voice AI platforms and Voice wholesale
  • Serve as the regional Voice expert for sales teams, CGEs and customers.
  • Gather market feedback, customer insights, and competitive intelligence for HQ.
  • Identify and validate newly created Voice AI platforms as Infobip ICPs.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with HQ and regional stakeholders to align product strategy and commercial initiatives.
  • Bridge NAM sales teams and the global Platform team through communication and knowledge sharing.
  • Monitor pipeline velocity, forecasting, account strategy, and planning to achieve commercial targets.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Background in business or product, with a strong understanding of sales and consultancy.
  • Proven experience in Voice product sales, with a track record of exceeding quota through outbound prospecting and self-generated pipeline.
  • Strong commercial mindset with analytical, sales acceleration, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience in solution selling, including proposals, value propositions, pricing, and contract negotiation.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with customer-facing confidence.
  • Proactive, self-starter mindset with a hunter attitude and the ability to work independently across North America.
  • Fluent in English; additional regional languages are a plus.
  • Willingness to travel to support key opportunities, field teams, and executive engagement with named accounts.
  • Open to travel within the U.S. based on customer and business needs.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work directly with key Voice customers and global players across North America.
  • The chance to work within a global Voice business unit with deep expertise.
  • Direct influence on Voice strategy execution in one of Infobip’s highest-growth regions.
  • High visibility and impact through collaboration with global product and business leadership.
  • Opportunity to contribute to Voice innovations
  • Career progression opportunities in a rapidly growing product domain across multiple industries.




Why you'll love it here

• Financial rewards & recognition - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
• Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.
• ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) - As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
• Work-life balance and Well-being - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
• Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
• Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.
• International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.



Additional Information

Salary Range: $130,000-$180,000 USD annual base salary (the salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to internal equity, job-related knowledge, experience, education, and skillset). This role is also eligible for quarterly discretionary bonus.


Benefits & Perks: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance; Basic life insurance; 401(k) plan participation with company match; Short-term and long-term disability insurance; Wellness plan of up to $500/year pro-rated based on hire date; PTO: Accrual of up to twenty-three (23) vacation days per year, accrual of up to nine (9) sick days per year, plus carryover of up to nine (9) sick days annually; Additional leave time for marriage, relocation, bereavement, and other major life events; Twelve (12) weeks of paid parental leave; Participation in employee share ownership plan (ESOP); Fourteen (14) paid holidays annually.

While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.





Diversity drives connection

Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.

No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.

title: Advanced Systems Engineer
description:
Why Join Rincon Research Corporation (RRC)?


At Rincon Research Corporation, our primary business is innovating, developing, and fielding digital signal processing (DSP) products and services for the United States Defense and Intelligence Communities in support of national security.

Rincon Research Corporation (RRC), an employee-owned company, is seeking an Advanced Systems Engineer to work in a multi-disciplinary R&D environment with similarly motivated electrical engineers, mathematicians, computer scientists, and analysts who are collectively responsible for creating custom digital signal processing solutions and leveraging them to make an operational mission impact.

Come join the team that is creating cutting edge signal processing and geolocation systems for the future!

What are the primary responsibilities in the Advanced Systems Engineer position?


Core responsibilities include leading requirements development, system architecture and design, risk identification and mitigation. Strong written and verbal communication skills, the ability to produce clear, traceable technical documentation, and proficiency with modern engineering tools, test environments, and secure computing systems is paramount. The ability to work unsupervised with minimal direction and the ability to self-start is a must.


What required background will make you successful?

  • Degree (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related technical field
  • Expert system engineering knowledge across the full system lifecycle, including requirements analysis and allocation, system architecture and design, integration, test, transition to operations, and sustainment activities.
  • Ability to write test plans and procedures
  • Ability to write training material
  • Comfort with agile development methods in a dynamic environment
  • Technical Knowledge: Previous experience as a Systems Engineer, working with or for a large contractor on a Research and Development program is desired.
  • Problem-solving skills: Ability to perform systematic analysis of systems to identify software, hardware, and interface issues and support resolution across the system lifecycle is crucial.
  • Attention to detail: Ability to identify and articulate discrepancy reports outlining issues or bugs with mitigation response deadlines.
  • Analytical skills: Ability to develop and interpret complex technical requirements and associate those to system engineering milestones within the development lifecycle.
  • Collaboration: Ability to work with engineers and customer to develop a comprehensive Requirements Verification Traceability Matrix (RVTM)
  • Ability to obtain and maintain TS/SCI security clearance
  • US CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED


Preferred skills:

  • Current TS/SCI Clearance
  • Lead in design reviews with customer-centric input
  • Strong communication skills for collaboration with diverse teams
  • Experience in developing Systems Engineering Management Plans (SEMP)
  • Experience in Systems Engineering Management Plan (SEMP) development
  • Experience developing system documentation to include the following:
    • Requirements Development
    • Formal Technical Reviews and Artifacts
    • Formal and Informal Test Processes
  • System Requirements Review (SRR)
  • Preliminary Design Review (PDR)
  • Critical Design Review / Critical Design Readiness Review (CDR/CDRR)
  • CONOP documents

Where is the position located?

This position is located at our Colorado Springs, CO location.

*The likely salary range for this position is $175,000 to $205,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

What benefits does RRC offer?

  • 100% employer-paid premiums for family medical and dental insurance, employee life insurance, short-term and long-term disability (STD & LTD)
  • Flexible reimbursement spending accounts for medical expense and dependent care
  • Immediate participation and vesting in the company’s Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) and 401(k) Plan
  • Employer contributions to RRC’s ESOP
  • Employer matching contributions to the company’s 401( k) Plan
  • Employer discretionary contributions to the company’s 401(k) Plan


Rincon Research Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor.

title: PACS ADMINISTRATOR
description:
CLOSING DATE: Open Until Filled (OUF)

Hourly Range: $32.25/hour - $40.31/hour

**APPLICANT MUST HAVE A VALID, UNRESTRICTED INSURABLE DRIVER’S LICENSE**

** RESUME AND REFERENCES ARE REQUIRED**

ESSENTIAL DUTIES, FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conducts daily monitoring of all clinical areas with Radiology imaging access to ensure all staff are able to access Radiology Images adequately to maintain continuity of patient care. Provide imaging management and support to those areas that need assistance and implements solutions for recurrent problems.
  • Ensure that all Radiology images cross between systems expediently and ensure all images are correctly labeled and transferred with correct patient data.
  • Check the PACS system daily to ensure accuracy, troubleshoot and resolve any issues or errors that are found or reported.
  • Act as a liaison for Radiology Services and Medical Staff who may need assistance in learning how to work with the varying imaging systems on viewing images, retrieving reports, and ordering exams.
  • Act as liaison between Radiology Services and Information Technology (IT) and Healthcare Technology Management staff to ensure that all systems are working in unison effectively and efficiently.
  • Ensure that the latest software updates/revisions being implemented in the hospital are compatible with the Radiology System and contingency plans are in place in case of emergencies.
  • Conduct daily checks on the Radiology UPS equipment and all other programs to maintain quality output and meet system specifications.
  • Work with EHR Clinical Applications Coordinator to ensure that the Radiology Department’s portion of the EHR and RPMS programs are up to date and to ensure information accuracy to help maintain the hospital’s overall compliance.
  • Implement new PACS systems and functionality.
  • Monitor and administer all PACS related portals.
  • Monitor and communicate unread/unreconciled exams to clinical teams on a daily basis.
  • Provide training and support to end-users on PACS functionalities.
  • Manage and maintain the primary PACS system in collaboration with vendors and strategic partners.
  • Assist with managing, supporting, interfacing or training of various PACS systems used by groups with whom FDIHB has contractual reading relationships.
  • Reconcile and troubleshoot daily report distribution to referring physicians.
  • Coordinate with Radiologists, Technologists, IT and Health Information Management staff to ensure seamless operation of the PACS system.
  • Respond to on call services in a timely manner.
  • Provide 24/7 maintenance of systems.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

MANDATORY MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Experience:

  • Two (2) years of direct work experience in Health Information Technology (HIT) and/or Radiology PACS systems.

Education:

  • Associate’s degree in Radiology Information System (RIS), Health Information Technology (HIT), or Information Technology (IT).

Licensure/Certifications:

  • Certified PACS Associate (CPAS) through the PACS Administrators Registry and Certification Association (PARCA) and must maintain certification. OR
  • Certified Imaging Informatics Professional (CIIP) through the American Board of
    Imaging Informatics (ABII) and must maintain certification.

**Please email degree, transcripts, license & certifications to vanessa.apachee@fdihb.org**

NAVAJO/INDIAN PREFERENCE
FDIHB and its facilities are located within the Navajo Nation and, in accordance with Navajo Nation law, has implemented a Navajo/Indian Preference in Employment Policy. Pursuant to this Policy, applicants who meet the minimum qualifications for this position and who are enrolled members of the Navajo Nation will be given primary preference in hiring and employment for this position and members of other federally-recognized Indian tribes will be given secondary preference. Other candidates will be considered only after all candidates entitled to primary or secondary preference have been fully considered.

description:

  3. Manage vendors for outsourced services and projects.

  6. Maintain and support security policy and procedures.
  7. Be on call to support the infrastructure as needed.

  18. Occasional travel may be required.

  20. Other duties as assigned.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work only. They are not an exhaustive list of all required responsibilities, duties, and skills. Other duties may be added, or this job description amended at any time.

This role has no supervisory duties.

QUALIFICATIONS

MCSA: Windows Server or MCSE: Server Infrastructure, or MCSE (or comparable) preferred.

Citrix CCA, CCAA, CCEE, or CCIA preferred.

Experience PREFERRED:

7+ yrs. Enterprise Data Center and Server experience

7+ yrs. Enterprise Windows Administration

7+ yrs. Microsoft infrastructure technologies (DNS, DHCP, DFS) specifically relating to multiple data centers and fault tolerance.

7+ yrs. Backup and Recovery systems

7+ yrs. Enterprise network monitoring

5+ yrs. Microsoft Exchange or equivalent

5+ yrs. SPAM filtering systems

4+ yrs. Data Center virtualization

3+ yrs. SQL Administration

2+ yrs. Load Balancers

1+ yrs. SIEM, preferably Alert Logic or similar

1+ yrs. Nexpose, Rapid 7 Vulnerability scanners

CISSP Certification

IT Banking

Linux support and administration

General knowledge of compliance and regulations procedures

Project management skills or PMI certification

Vulnerability Management and Server Automation tools

Be a hands-on with proactive attitude.

Enjoy complex technical challenges.

Must be willing to travel – at least 10%.

Must be willing to work after-hours.

Must display a positive team working attitude with associates in all departments.

Position Title:

Fish Screening, Passage and Restoration Coordinator (Natural Resource Specialist 2)

Job Description:

Help the Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife fulfill its mission: To protect and enhance Oregon's fish and wildlife and their habitats for use and enjoyment by present and future generations.


We are hiring for one full-time, permanent position located in Klamath Falls, Oregon.


What you will do:

In this role, you will be tasked with advancing ODFW priorities for fish screening, fish passage and aquatic restoration efforts in the Klamath Watershed. The position is a critical liaison between project proponents, the fish screening program, fish passage program and Habitat Division. You will be responsible for outreach and providing technical assistance to irrigation districts, water users, watershed councils and conservation groups in the Klamath Basin. Additionally, you will perform data collection, analysis, and evaluation for potential fish screening and passage projects and associated habitat restoration projects, as well as project coordination. You will be part of the Klamath Watershed District and as such, will have the opportunity to participate in a wide range of other fish, wildlife, and habitat related activities throughout the Klamath Basin.


This position will also require the successful candidate to either possess or obtain an All-Terrain Vehicle Safety Education card and a Boater Education Card within the first 6 months of hire.


The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required.


For a full review of the position details, duties, and working conditions, please review the position description located here.


Clearly describe how you meet the desired attributes in your application materials. We cannot accept additional application materials after the application deadline. Be sure your work and education history is accurate, thorough, and fully reflects your skills and experience, even if they do not seem directly related to the position. Click here to learn more about Equal Pay Analysis and What You Need to Know to Get the Job


What we are looking for:


Minimum Qualifications:

To be considered for this position, applicants must meet one of the following options:

  • Option 1: Six years of biological experience performing studies, research, or resource management activities in a fish or wildlife program that included one year of at least two of the following: gathering data, analyzing data, or preparing reports
  • Option 2: Two years of biological experience performing studies, research, or resource management activities in a fish or wildlife program that included one year of at least two of the following: gathering data, analyzing data, or preparing reports, AND a Bachelor's degree in Fisheries or Wildlife Science, or a closely related Bachelor’s degree with at least 45 quarter (30 semester) hours of biological/ecological coursework
  • Option 3: One year biological experience performing studies, research, or resource management activities in a fish or wildlife program that included at least two of the following: gathering data, analyzing data, or preparing reports, AND a Master's degree Fisheries or Wildlife Science, or a closely related Master’s degree in biological/ecological sciences
  • Option 4: A Doctorate degree in Fisheries or Wildlife Science, or a closely related Doctorate degree in biological/ecological sciences.

Note: Applicants who have obtained a Master’s degree or Doctorate that included work experience from an internship, work/study, thesis, or similar program may list this experience in their application to receive credit for the work experience. The Master’s degree/Doctorate and applicable work experience will be considered separately, and both the education and applicable experience may count toward minimum qualifications.


Desired Attributes:

  • Proven experience collaborating with other entities which may include: Tribes, watershed councils, non-governmental organizations, water users, and private landowners to advance fish and/or wildlife habitat projects.
  • Experience in providing technical expertise for fish, wildlife, or habitat related projects.
  • Experience implementing aquatic or riparian restoration projects.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain successful interagency, Tribal, and non-governmental partnerships.
  • Excellent public speaking, writing, and outreach abilities.
  • Ability to use persuasive diplomacy while working with landowners, partner agencies, and the public.
  • Experience with fish passage and screening technology and solutions.

After you submit your application, be sure to respond to the two questionnaires relating to public records requests and veterans’ preference immediately following your submittal. These questions are necessary to complete the application process
  • If you are experiencing difficulty applying for this position or have questions, please call 503.947.6051 and ask to speak to a recruiter.

ODFW is dedicated to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce as we strive to represent and better serve our neighboring communities. Our most important asset is our employees, and each person brings unique, different, and important contributions to the workplace and community we serve. The Oregon coast attracts thousands of people who clam, crab and fish in the ocean for halibut, salmon, and tuna. The outdoor opportunities are endless when it comes to fish and wildlife in Oregon! title: Mine Maintenance Planner

Uses handheld scanner device (RF) to verify merchandise. Moves merchandise from sales floor to staging area.

  • Performs other duties as assigned, including working in other departments as needed.

Qualifications

  • Big box/wholesale retail experience preferred.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – NLP/LLM
location: United States of America, Brooklyn, New York
description:
Job Description

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will build and deploy production machine learning and large language model (LLM) systems that extract actionable insights from complex legal documents and data. You will work on challenging natural language processing problems involving contractual language, information extraction, model-driven analysis, and comparisons across large collections of documents.

You will join a highly technical machine learning team and collaborate with machine learning engineers, legal subject matter experts, product engineers, and data and security partners. This is a hands-on role for someone who has personally built, trained, evaluated, and deployed machine learning models into production and wants to apply that expertise to sophisticated real-world products.

This role may be remote within the United States or hybrid from our New York City office.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, train, and deploy machine learning and LLM-based models and systems that solve complex natural language processing and document intelligence problems.
  • Develop production solutions for areas such as information extraction, text generation and summarization, AI agents, search, and document analysis.
  • Build scalable and reliable machine learning pipelines that support model training, evaluation, deployment, and ongoing production use.
  • Develop rigorous model evaluation frameworks and metrics to assess model quality, accuracy, reliability, drift, and potential bias.
  • Optimize model performance and resource utilization through experimentation, feature engineering, model selection, and tuning.
  • Translate complex business and product problems into practical machine learning solutions and take those solutions from experimentation through production deployment at scale.
  • Collaborate across machine learning, engineering, product, legal domain, data, and security teams to deliver reliable AI capabilities while protecting sensitive information.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative field with a focus on machine learning or artificial intelligence.
  • 3+ years of professional machine learning engineering, applied machine learning, research engineering, or closely related software engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building, training, and deploying machine learning models into production, including the ability to explain your individual contribution from model development through production deployment.
  • Strong practical experience with machine learning, natural language processing, and modern LLM architectures.
  • Experience with at least one of the following: information extraction, text generation/summarization, AI agents, or search.
  • Advanced Python programming skills and hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Experience developing or fine-tuning language models or other machine learning models for specialized use cases or domains.
  • Experience designing and applying model evaluation methods and metrics to measure the performance and reliability of production machine learning systems.
  • Ability to translate product or business problems into machine learning solutions and clearly communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and outcomes.
  • Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and ownership skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and domain-focused teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative field.
  • Experience deploying and operating ML or LLM systems at scale in production environments.
  • Experience with legal technology, legal natural language processing, legal document analysis, or other domain-specific language modeling.
  • Experience applying machine learning within financial services, economics, or other regulated or data-sensitive industries.
  • Experience serving or self-hosting large language models and optimizing model performance and computational efficiency.
  • Experience taking complex ML initiatives from experimentation or research through production and demonstrating measurable product or business impact.

title: Inernal Audit Intern (AI & Analytics)
location: SALT LAKE CITY, Utah, United States
description:
FJ Management (FJM) is a privately held, Utah-based holding company whose businesses include Maverik (convenience retail and fuel), Big West Oil (petroleum refining), and other operating businesses.

Our Internal Audit team provides independent assurance and advisory services across all FJM businesses. Our work spans store operations, fuel and inventory, pricing and promotions, labor and payroll, facilities, regulatory and environmental compliance, third-party risk, finance and accounting, and information technology. AI is built into how we work: our audit management platform is connected to AI tools, we maintain a shared library of prompts for specific audit tasks, and we are building a knowledge base from the results of our work. We hold AI-assisted work to the same standards of accuracy, evidence, and confidentiality as everything else we produce.

We are looking for an intern who enjoys learning unfamiliar subjects, asking thoughtful questions, and finding practical solutions. You do not need to arrive as an auditor, accountant, or software developer. We are more interested in how you approach a problem, use the resources available to you, and determine whether your answer is reliable.

You will work alongside our auditors and our Data Analytics & Automation team on real engagements across the business. Part of your time will support audit projects directly. The rest will go toward improving how the team works: finding tasks AI can do better, building and testing the approach, and helping the team adopt it.

In return, you will see a wider range of businesses than most internships offer (retail, refining, transportation, and corporate functions), apply AI to professional work under the review of experienced auditors, and gain a clear view of how a company identifies and manages risk.

POSITION DETAILS:

  • Schedule: Part-time, approximately 20 hours per week, with flexibility around class schedules.
  • Location: Salt Lake City, Utah.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Audit work

  • Support audit projects: Assist with planning and performing audits under the guidance of the audit team. Help understand business processes, gather supporting information, identify potential risks, and evaluate whether procedures and controls are working as intended. Help draft walkthrough documentation and risk and control matrices.
  • Turn interviews into usable records: Use AI tools to convert meeting and interview transcripts into structured discussion records, reconcile what different people said about the same process, and identify gaps, inconsistencies, and follow-up evidence requests.
  • Analyze data: Work with the Data Analytics & Automation team to organize and analyze business data (for example, transaction, pricing, inventory, or payroll data) to test controls and identify exceptions or trends.
  • Prepare clear documentation: Organize evidence and document work performed, results, and conclusions so another team member can understand and review the work. Assist with drafting audit findings and reports and help track remediation of open issues with business owners.
  • Collaborate across the business: Participate in meetings, ask questions to understand how work is performed, follow up on information requests, and communicate progress and results professionally.

AI and team improvement

  • Build and improve AI-assisted workflows: Identify repetitive or time-consuming steps in audit work, then design, test, and document AI-assisted approaches the team can adopt. Help develop and maintain the team's library of reusable audit prompts, testing them against real examples and refining them when results fall short.
  • Validate AI-generated work: Check AI output against source evidence, compare results across AI models where useful, flag errors or unsupported conclusions, and document how AI was used so a reviewer can follow and rely on the work.
  • Build the team's knowledge base: Help organize and classify information from audit results and business discussions into a structured knowledge base so the team can find and reuse what it has learned.
  • Support AI adoption beyond audit: Assist with advisory projects that help other business teams design and test AI-assisted workflows for their own processes.
  • Exercise sound judgment: Protect confidential information, follow company AI use and data handling requirements, and recognize when a task requires additional guidance or expertise. Take ownership of the final work product.

Perform other related duties and support team projects as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

We are looking for someone who demonstrates:

  • Practical AI proficiency: Hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools to accomplish meaningful tasks, including the ability to break a problem into steps, write clear prompts, refine an approach when results fall short, and explain how the final output was checked.
  • Critical thinking and attention to detail: Ability to question assumptions, recognize inconsistencies, distinguish evidence from speculation, and determine when more information is needed.
  • Curiosity and resourcefulness: Willingness to learn unfamiliar business processes and tools, research questions independently, try different approaches, and ask for help when appropriate.
  • Clear communication and collaboration: Ability to explain ideas and results in understandable language, write organized documentation, listen to others, and incorporate feedback.
  • Reliability and organization: Ability to manage assigned tasks, meet commitments, communicate obstacles early, and follow through.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Required

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in any field.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools to complete meaningful work (coursework, jobs, or personal projects).
  • Ability to commit to approximately 20 hours per week.

Preferred

  • Coursework in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Experience with data analysis tools such as SQL, Python, R, Alteryx, or ACL.
  • Experience with scripting, low-code tools, or version control (e.g., Git) to build repeatable workflows.
  • Experience organizing data, researching unfamiliar topics, or improving a process.

description:

  • Demonstrated experience supporting production chemistry programs for U.S. land-based oil and gas operations.

  • Experience operating and troubleshooting ICP-OES, Ion Chromatography (IC), Gas Chromatography (GC), XRF, or equivalent analytical instrumentation.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, etc) and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), with experience leveraging data management and reporting tools to support laboratory operations, decision-making, and process improvement.

Required Skills & Experience (Must – Haves)

  • Demonstrated success working within a small laboratory team where collaboration, flexibility, and individual accountability are critical to overall laboratory performance.
  • Demonstrate initiative and ability to work independently and handle multiple tasks.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a strong commitment to safety, quality, and customer responsiveness.
  • Demonstrated desire and initiative to grow into leadership roles over time, including taking on increased responsibility, mentoring peers, and contributing to team development.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Physically able to lift 50 pounds, climb stairs or ladder, and agile enough to squat and bend over.
  • Ability to independently prioritize tasks, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage a high-volume workload (handling up to 1,000 samples per month).

Preferred Skills & Experience (Nice to Have)

  • Proven ability to foster a collaborative, respectful, and solutions-oriented work environment through effective communication and constructive engagement with colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Experience presenting technical findings, managing projects, and collaborating effectively across functional teams.
  • Understanding of customer needs and ability to translate analytical data into actionable operational insights.
  • Experience identifying and implementing process improvements that enhance laboratory efficiency, quality, safety, or customer service.

Job Duties:

  • Lead and execute routine and non-routine analytical testing activities in support of customer programs, field operations, and laboratory service commitments.
  • Apply advanced production chemistry knowledge and sound technical judgment to troubleshoot challenges, validate methods, interpret analytical data, and solve complex problems.
  • Support customer programs by designing, conducting, and interpreting laboratory analyses tied to real-world field performance and operational outcomes.
  • Independently manage multiple priorities, project deadlines, customer requests, and stakeholder communications in a fast-paced laboratory environment.
  • Manage high volumes of routine analytical testing while maintaining quality, accuracy, data integrity, and turnaround time expectations.
  • Operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize laboratory instrumentation while ensuring compliance with established QA/QC procedures and laboratory standards.
  • Support the mentoring, training, and development of chemists, technicians, and technologists through coaching, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance.
  • Collaborate with field personnel, sales, technical teams, and customers to translate analytical data into actionable recommendations.

title: Emissions Technician - West Texas
description:
As an Emissions Technician with SM Energy, you will be responsible for conducting LDAR (Leak Detection & Repair) surveys throughout West Texas to ensure compliance with federal and state environmental regulations. This role is largely field-based and involves driving to multiple locations to complete these surveys. This role will also have an office component to attend meetings, compile data, and complete any reports. The Emissions Technician will report to the Air Supervisor - Field Air Compliance and will be responsible for communicating project progress, and repairs to internal and external or contract teams.

Role/Responsibilities

  • Conduct routine OGI (Optical Gas Imaging), AVO (Audio, Visual & Olfactory) and Method 22 LDAR inspections at a variety of locations in West Texas on varying schedules.
  • OGI surveys will be required to be completed with an OGI Camera (camera will be provided by the company).
  • Perform or schedule the inspection, calibration, and basic maintenance on environmental monitoring equipment.
  • Responsible for logging LDAR data after surveys are complete.
  • Communicate findings and assist in coordinating corrective measures with field and operations personnel and confirm repairs have been made via OGI camera.
  • Maintain knowledge and fluency with current and changing regulatory laws for the projects managed.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the team members may travel extensively to fieldwork sites and be required to deliver results on strict deadlines.
  • Understand field safety protocols in varying weather conditions.
  • Participate in safety meetings, team meetings, and other environmental compliance briefings.
  • Maintain detailed and organized records of field data, inspections, and corrective actions.
  • Other duties and training assigned.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years’ LDAR survey experience (OGI, AVO, Method 22 surveys).
  • Current Optical Gas Imaging (OGI) certification required. Proof of certification required upon hire.
  • Experience with entering LDAR data, using multiple LDAR database platforms (mobile app and desktop) required.
  • Familiarity with EPA Method 22, LDAR programs (OGI, AVO), and emissions monitoring protocols, and repair time frames.
  • Minimum 2 years’ Oil and Gas/industry field experience.
  • Oil & Gas industry knowledge, with strong mechanical aptitude, knowledge of equipment and component types on oilfield equipment required.
  • Use of MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Vizio, Teams), Adobe Products, etc., required. Use of basic office equipment: scanner, copier, and laptop.
  • Experience or knowledge with high H2S areas and corresponding safety procedures is required.
  • Will be required to wear FR apparel and other required safety equipment while in all field locations including but not limited to an H2S monitor, hard hat and approved work boots all year round.

Skills

  • Maintain a positive attitude with the ability to multi-task and work well in groups or as part of a team.
  • Ability to work safely in a field environment, while driving a company vehicle and in an office environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (Internally and with Clients/Consultants).
  • Ability to work independently in field environments and communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • College background in environmental science or related subjects recommended/ preferred.

Location/Schedule/Travel Requirements

  • West Texas
  • Must reside within the area or be willing to relocate.
  • 5 days on (M-F) and 2 days off (Sat, Sun)
  • Valid driver's license: ability to travel to multiple field locations as required in a company vehicle.
  • Must maintain company vehicle and follow the company driving safe work practices.
  • Attend driver safety training and other required safety training courses from the company.

title: Assoc. Director, IT Business Partner - Pharmaceutical Development
description:
COMPANY:

At BioCryst, we share a deep commitment to improving the lives of people living with hereditary angioedema (HAE) and other rare diseases. We leverage our expertise in structure-guided drug design to develop first-in-class or best-in-class oral small-molecule and injectable protein therapeutics. Our global headquarters is in Durham, North Carolina, we have a regional office in Boston, Massachusetts, and our employees span the globe across sites in multiple countries. We are proud of our culture of engagement and accountability that rewards people for innovative thinking and achievement of key objectives. For more information, please visit our website at or follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.


JOB SUMMARY:

BioCryst is a fast-growing pharmaceutical company seeking an experienced Associate Director, IT Business - Partner Pharmaceutical Development to build and mature strategic partnerships across Development. The role supports Program & Portfolio Management, Clinical Development / Operations, Biometrics, Pharmacology / Non-Clinical, Regulatory, Safety, and Medical Affairs. The IT Business Partner will understand functional strategies and operating needs, translate them into technology roadmaps and prioritized initiatives, and enable compliant, scalable process and system improvements across the development lifecycle. This role serves as a strategic technology advisor and delivery leader, with responsibility for business analysis, program and project leadership, solution design, data and integration strategy, vendor management, adoption, and ongoing application support. The role requires working knowledge of key Development platforms and capabilities, including Veeva RIM, Veeva CTMS, ReadCube, clinical data visualization and analytics solutions, and the Oracle Argus safety system. Please note: this role can be remote working east coast with a strong preference for the Boston, MA area. #LI-REMOTE


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Serve as the primary IT Business Partner and trusted technology advisor for Program & Portfolio Management, Clinical Development / Operations, Biometrics, Pharmacology / Non-Clinical, Regulatory, Safety, and Medical Affairs.

· Build strong partnerships with functional leaders and subject matter experts to understand strategies, business capabilities, pain points, risks, and priorities.

· Translate business priorities into multi-year technology roadmaps, business cases, demand plans, and sequenced delivery portfolios.

· Lead demand intake, discovery, requirements definition, solution evaluation, prioritization, implementation, adoption, and value realization for Development technology initiatives.

· Provide subject matter expertise for the selection, implementation, enhancement, integration, and support of Development applications and data capabilities.

· Partner with business and IT stakeholders to optimize platforms including Veeva RIM, Veeva CTMS, ReadCube, clinical data visualization and analytics solutions, Oracle Argus, and related Development systems.

· Develop a working understanding of Development processes and data flows, including clinical study operations, regulatory information and submissions, safety and pharmacovigilance, biometrics, non-clinical activities, processes, and medical information or evidence-generation needs.

· Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Data and Analytics, Information Security, Infrastructure, Integration, and IT Compliance teams to design scalable, secure, reliable, and supportable solutions.

· Ensure GxP and other regulated applications are implemented and maintained in accordance with applicable validation, data integrity, privacy, security, change control, and records-management requirements.

· Oversee system lifecycle activities, including application ownership, release management, vendor upgrades, incident and problem management, access governance, business continuity, disaster recovery, and application retirement.

· Promote consistent master data, system interoperability, and integrated data flows across internal platforms, CROs, service providers, and other Development partners.

· Partner with Clinical, Biometrics, and Data and Analytics teams to improve access to trusted study information and strengthen clinical data visualization, reporting, and decision support.

· Lead cross-functional programs and projects, managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, dependencies, decisions, communications, and executive-level status reporting.

· Manage strategic technology vendors and managed service providers, including performance, service levels, delivery quality, contracts, and issue escalation.

· Drive user adoption through stakeholder engagement, communications, training, process documentation, and change-management activities.

· Monitor emerging technologies, including automation, analytics, and responsible AI, and recommend practical opportunities that support Development priorities and compliance expectations.

· This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. The role leads and manages MSPs, contractors, vendors, and consultants, as needed, for project implementation, project delivery, and ongoing system support.

· Contribute to IT standards, policies, procedures, governance practices, and continuous-improvement efforts.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:

· Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, business, life sciences, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

· At least 8–10 years of progressive experience delivering and managing information technologies and services in a corporate environment, preferably in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or broader life sciences industry.

· Demonstrated experience as an IT Business Partner, product owner, application leader, program manager, or similar role supporting Development or R&D business functions.

· Strong knowledge of business processes and information needs across several of the following areas: Program & Portfolio Management, Clinical Development / Operations, Biometrics, Pharmacology / Non-Clinical, Regulatory, Safety, and Medical Affairs.

· Experience in managing, enhancing, integrating, or supporting Veeva RIM and Veeva CTMS or comparable regulatory and clinical platforms.

· Knowledge of Oracle Argus or a comparable pharmacovigilance and safety system.

· Knowledge of SAS (LSAF) and A2Ai

· Knowledge of ReadCube or comparable scientific literature and reference-management solutions.

· Knowledge of clinical data sources, standards, reporting, and visualization approaches used to support study oversight and Development decision-making.

· Experience with regulated GxP computerized systems, including validation, data integrity, audit trails, electronic records and signatures, security, change control, and inspection readiness.

· Experience leading application implementations and lifecycle management in cloud-based, client-server, and web-based environments.

· Experience with system integrations, data flows, vendor-hosted platforms, and external partners such as CROs and managed service providers.

· Strong business analysis, process-improvement, solution-evaluation, program and project management, resource planning, and vendor-management skills.

· Demonstrated ability to develop technology roadmaps, investment proposals, implementation plans, operating models, and measurable outcomes.

· Experience leading contractors, and external partners in a matrixed and cross-functional environment.

· Strong interpersonal, written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with business leaders, technical teams, end users, and vendors.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate ambiguity, influence without direct authority, and work effectively both as a leader and as a contributing team member.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
description:
SENIOR FULL-STACK DEVELOPER

Location | Gothenburg, Sweden

Hybrid Work Model

ROLE OVERVIEW

Hands-on senior full-stack engineering role combining AWS cloud-native development, technical ownership, architectural collaboration and delivery leadership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full-Stack Developer, you will play a key role in shaping the technical direction and implementation of partner-enabled services. You will work closely with Solution Architects, Project Managers, Full-Stack Developers, Designers, Product Managers, Business Analysts, and UI/UX specialists to enhance and scale the existing service portfolio, partner enablers, APIs, and developer platform.

This is a hands-on position for an experienced engineer who can take technical ownership, contribute throughout the development lifecycle, and help create scalable, maintainable, secure, and high-performing solutions across back-end and front-end applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Drive technical work together with the Project Manager and Solution Architect. Take ownership of development tasks, contribute hands‑on, lead technical initiatives, conduct code reviews, provide technical guidance, and promote continuous improvement.
  • System Development & Implementation: Design, develop, maintain, and evolve partner solutions, reusable components, service enablers, APIs, and full-stack applications using modern engineering practices.
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Work with architecture, product, design, business analysis, UI/UX, and development teams to understand requirements, define technical solutions, and ensure seamless front‑end and back‑end integration.
  • Architectural Support: Support the Solution Architect with application architecture and technical roadmap activities. Advocate scalable and maintainable designs and evaluate technologies and frameworks that can improve engineering efficiency and user experience.
  • Quality Engineering: Establish and follow coding standards, development best practices, automated testing strategies, code reviews, performance optimization, and engineering quality controls to deliver reliable solutions.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain technical documentation, development guidelines, reusable patterns, and team standards. Participate in onboarding, workshops, and knowledge‑sharing activities.
  • Innovation & AI Enablement: Explore and apply modern engineering practices, including AI‑assisted development, where appropriate to improve productivity, delivery speed, and software quality.
  • API & Service Evolution: Help drive the evolution of partner service enablers and APIs, ensuring consistency, scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability across applications.

Must-Have Skills

  • Strong professional experience with TypeScript and modern full-stack application development.
  • Deep hands‑on experience with AWS, including serverless architectures and cloud‑native services.
  • Hands‑on development experience with Node.js and React.js.
  • Experience designing, developing, and integrating REST APIs or comparable service interfaces.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC); practical AWS CDK experience is strongly preferred.
  • Understanding of scalable application architecture, reusable components, integration patterns, performance, and maintainability.
  • Experience with automated testing, code reviews, coding standards, debugging, performance optimization, and software quality practices.
  • Ability to take technical ownership and move development forward in collaboration with architects, project leads, and cross‑functional stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical problem‑solving skills and the ability to break complex problems into manageable technical solutions.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience in the automotive industry or an automotive‑related digital/service environment.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS CDK, if IaC experience has primarily been gained with other tools.
  • Experience with AI‑assisted software development, generative AI tools, or other modern innovation practices that improve engineering productivity.
  • Experience contributing to architectural design, technology evaluation, and application technical roadmaps.
  • Experience creating reusable developer‑platform components, partner enablers, SDKs, or service frameworks.
  • Experience facilitating technical workshops, onboarding engineers, mentoring, or sharing development standards and patterns.
  • Ability to create and present technical concepts and innovative ideas to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or another relevant field.

Experience

Recommended experience level: 6+ years of professional software development experience, with several years of hands‑on full-stack development in complex production environments. Candidates should demonstrate senior-level technical ownership and strong practical experience with the core stack rather than only listed skills or certifications.

The original requirement specifies several years of experience in complex software development without stating an exact number. The 6+ years threshold is therefore an appropriate recruiting benchmark for the level of technical ownership, hands‑on delivery, code review, architectural participation, and guidance expected in this role.

Location & Work Model

  • Primary location: Lindholmen Science Park, Gothenburg, Sweden.
  • Hybrid work model, combining office‑based work with working from home a few days each week.
  • Candidates who are not EU citizens must hold a valid work permit for Sweden.

title: Senior Program Officer, AI & Digital Health Delivery (3-year LTE)
description:
The Foundation

We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The Team

The Global Development Division (GD) works with partners to expand access to life-saving health products and services in under-resourced communities, supporting countries in strengthening health systems and advancing essential services for women, children, and families. The division includes teams focused on Emergency Response, Exemplars in Global Health, Global Health Agencies and Funds, Immunization, and Polio - stewarding approximately $1.5 billion in annual grant funding across a team of roughly 185 staff.

The Exemplars in Global Health (EGH) team equips decision-makers with the evidence, insights, and practical “know-how” needed to accelerate and scale interventions that improve the health of the world’s most vulnerable populations. Working with a global network of partners, EGH identifies and studies exemplars and best practices across health outcomes, primary health care systems, and service delivery strategies.

Through rigorous research, evidence synthesis, and timely analysis, EGH translates lessons from what works into actionable insights that help policymakers, practitioners, and funders strengthen systems, improve service delivery, and address pressing global health challenges.

We pursue this through:
1. The study of “positive outliers”- identifying countries or regions that have achieved exceptional progress in health outcomes and analyzing the drivers behind their success;
2. The study of emerging practices with global learning value, using prospective research and real-time analytics alongside implementation to meet the ambition of ‘learning by doing’;
3. The provision of internal advisory services to support teams in pursuit of the foundation’s three goals toward 2045; and
4. External partnerships to scale exemplary practices with governments, policymakers, global health initiatives, and multilateral development banks.

This role is embedded within the Africa Team, formalizing a learning partnership between Africa’s AI & Digital function and EGH's AI & Digital Health Evidence & Learning sub-team, and helping ensure EGH's research and evidence offerings are tailored to Africa and priority-country needs, while Africa Team's frontline experience informs EGH's global learning agenda.

Your Role

The Senior Program Officer (SPO), AI & Digital Health Delivery will play a critical role in advancing AI-driven solutions to strengthen primary health care and health systems in Africa. This is an individual contributor role which will shape and manage a portfolio of AI and health delivery investments across multiple geographies and multiple levels of a health system, focusing on solutions that align with government priorities and the foundation’s health goals. This position is part of the Exemplars in Global Health (EGH) team, embedded in the Africa Regional Office (ARO), and will focus on building and evidence and learning portfolio across Africa to inform how AI and digital health delivery can effectively scale. As such, the role will also provide technical expertise at the intersection of AI, digital health, and health delivery, to the Ethiopia Country Office (ECO), the Nigeria Country Office (NCO), ARO; and EGH.

The successful candidate will bring technical expertise in AI and digital systems in healthcare, a deep understanding of primary health care and health systems programming in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), and a passion for improving evidence-based health outcomes through innovative technology.

This is a limited-term employee (LTE) position with a three-year term, based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The postholder will report directly to the Deputy Director, Leadership Advising, Africa.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify, develop, and manage a multi-country portfolio of investments in AI and digital health that strengthen primary health care delivery and health systems in priority geographies and/or which complement EGH’s broader learning agenda (e.g. Ethiopia, Nigeria).
  • Lead due diligence, define results frameworks, milestones, and KPIs, monitor performance against them, and make clear recommendations on renewal, restructuring, or exit.
  • Ensure investments demonstrate a credible pathway to government adoption and public value, including how AI can improve quality, coverage, workforce productivity, or resource allocation within constrained government budgets. Assess recurrent costs, affordability, and sustainability - not only technical performance.
  • Lead bidirectional engagement between the EGH team and ECO and NCO - ensuring that AI and digital health delivery investments are informed by global research and evidence; and that global research and evidence is informed by lessons from on-the-ground delivery and government priorities.
  • Serve as the day-to-day technical resource to the ECO and the NCO on the design, procurement, deployment, scaling of, and evidence generation from AI and digital health solutions for primary health care.
  • Strengthen government capability to identify high-value AI opportunities, make informed build/buy/partner decisions, procure and govern AI responsibly, manage technology partners, and integrate successful solutions into routine government systems and budgets.
  • Support counterparts in the ARO on their AI and digital health investments - sharing evidence and learnings from EGH’s work to inform design and deployment decisions.
  • Provide day-to-day technical and analytical support to teams considering or managing investments in AI and digital health, including reviewing proposals and preparing technical inputs, with lens of how to accelerate real-time learning during implementation.
  • Advise on use cases across consumer, provider, and program intelligence: including patient engagement and self-care, clinical decision support in the hands of frontline health workers, and tools for health system administration.
  • Support effective bidirectional engagement between primary care platforms and priority health areas (e.g. immunization, maternal newborn child health and nutrition, family planning, malaria, HIV and TB), to identify how AI investments can strengthen the platform rather than fragment it.
  • Provide technical support and guidance to ensure new tools integrate with, rather than sit alongside, existing systems and workflows.
  • Partner with the Deputy Director, AI & Digital, ARO, and other AI program leads to represent Africa Team and EGH on internal AI for health committees (as relevant) and contribute to the development of AI and digital health strategies and frameworks at the foundation.
  • Identify how real-time learning at the country-level can inform EGH’s cross-country and global learning agenda, intended to shape how governments and global health institutions further invest in AI-enabled tools for health delivery.
  • Identify how factors in the broader infrastructure and ecosystem - such as ethics, data governance, regulatory, and other policy considerations - influence AI deployment. Bring a strong monitoring and evaluation (M&E) perspective to identify when and how AI makes a difference in impact outcomes.
  • Synthesize lessons from the investment portfolio and from country delivery experience into a practical evidence base on when and how AI and digital tools strengthen health systems - and when they do not - in partnership with EGH’s AI & Digital Health Evidence & Learning sub-team.
  • Identify and track promising innovations from proof-of-concept to sustainable scale, flagging risks, capability gaps, and opportunities to country office, Africa Team, and EGH leadership.
  • Prepare briefs, technical inputs, investment memos, and presentations that translate complex technical and research findings into clear, actionable recommendations for internal and external audiences, including senior foundation leadership.
  • Build and maintain working relationships with regional technical partners, government counterparts, and academic institutions engaged in AI and digital health. This includes serving as a trusted partner to government counterparts, providing strategic advice and connecting them with relevant regional and global expertise, evidence, resources, and networks to advance shared priorities and strengthen impact.
  • Map and coordinate the AI and digital-health ecosystem in priority countries, helping government and Foundation teams align technology companies, local innovators, academic institutions, implementers, and funders around country priorities; identify duplication early and promote interoperable, reusable approaches rather than parallel solutions.
  • Stay current on the fast-evolving AI and digital health landscape, particularly as it applies to African health systems and primary health care delivery, and flag relevant developments to Africa Team and EGH leadership.

Your Experience

  • Education: Advanced degree in public health, medicine, data science, computer science, engineering, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
  • Technical background: At least 10 years of senior-level experience advancing digital and AI-driven solutions to strengthen primary health care and health systems in Africa and/or leading related learning initiatives focused on applied data science, AI, digital health, or a related technical field, including applying innovative technologies to improve evidence generation, decision-making, and health outcomes is essential. Experience in global health programming - ideally focused on primary health care and health systems strengthening - is strongly preferred.
  • Expertise: Familiarity with AI applications in healthcare and public health contexts, particularly in low-resource settings.
  • Programmatic knowledge: Proven knowledge of primary health care delivery and health systems strengthening in LMICs, including the interface between primary care platforms and priority health areas such as immunization, maternal and child health, malaria, HIV and TB, and nutrition.
  • Investment and portfolio management: Grant making and portfolio management experience, including due diligence, investment structuring, and managing a portfolio of grants or projects through to results.
  • Government and partner engagement: Experience engaging governments, Ministries of Health, NGOs, implementing partners, academic institutions, and global funders, with a demonstrated ability to rapidly build trusted-advisor relationships with senior counterparts.
  • Communication skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels, including preparing technical materials for varied audiences and working effectively across barriers of language, culture, and distance.
  • Problem-solving: Ability to identify key issues, design innovative solutions, and execute them effectively within complex healthcare environments, with comfort in highly unstructured and ambiguous situations.
  • Strategic thinking: Ability to align AI solutions with long-term programmatic goals and impact metrics, and to identify second-order implications and evidence gaps.
  • Cultural and contextual fluency: At least three years’ experience living and working in LMICs. Comfortable operating across diverse country contexts, with cultural sensitivity and adaptability.
  • Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a multi-disciplinary, cross-functional team and across a matrix.
  • Innovation: Capacity to drive innovative thinking and bring creative AI solutions to global health challenges, with intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and a learning orientation in a fast-evolving field.

Other Attributes

  • Demonstrates cultural sensitivity and adaptability across diverse cultural, geographic, and operational contexts, with a proven commitment to development issues and the highest standards of integrity.
  • Ability to travel up to 30% within the African continent, and globally (including to the USA).

title: Technical Program Manager, PMO
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Maritime Manufacturing Technology Team is responsible for rapidly developing and implementing manufacturing technologies, processes, and materials for cutting-edge defense hardware. The team is developing deployable static and moving surfaces, undersea and sea to air vehicles, and scaling these products in our new manufacturing facilities.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking our next Technical Program Manager to join our emerging Program Management Office in Santa Ana, CA, working in a cutting-edge start-up environment to advance the state-of-the-possible in subsea robotics. Working across product, engineering, business development, logistics, and operations, you must be a technical leader with the expertise to evaluate, qualify, manage, and advocate for an increasing number of sophisticated parallel pursuits.

This role is crucial in ensuring that each initiative aligns with the company's strategic direction and receives the appropriate resourcing, balancing innovation with practical execution to drive this novel business line's success. You will be required to learn technical concepts and employ them quickly. You will be expected to use your technical knowledge in conjunction with your program management skills to lead cross-functional efforts and deliver exceptional outcomes.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Technical Ownership: Drive technical outcomes through meticulous understanding of system performance, managing incident response and after-action, using metrics to derive insights into areas for improvement, quantifying the improvements made through investment in those areas, and maintaining a clear understanding of the state of the system that can be communicated to the customer.
  • Project Planning: Develop project scope and manage changes through the life of the project. Identify, track, and manage project risks. Generate and maintain project schedules. Ensure successful execution of programs in accordance with desired requirements, on schedule, and on budget.
  • New Product Integration: Lead NPI teams to ensure the end-to-end systems integration and manufacturing readiness of new products through to sustained high-rate production ensuring processes, work instructions, test coverage, and tooling are mature enough to rapidly scale complex hardware products. Design, implement, and continuously improve a standardized NPI knowledge transfer framework, including checklists, templates, communication plans, and stage-gate reviews.
  • Cross Functional Partnership: Deeply embed with the Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality and Manufacturing teams from early development through the initial production run to gain expert-level product and process knowledge.
  • Contract Management: Provide contract management support including statements of work, change orders, financial management, terms and conditions, data rights assertions, etc. Manage deliverables, including routine status updates and final delivery to the customer.
  • Autonomous Execution: Autonomously execute on broad and/or ambiguous requirements from internal and external clients. Demonstrate high ownership on all pieces of work. Become a trusted partner to Anduril’s engineers.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of experience specifically in technical project management and/or systems engineering, or related project management and/or systems engineering experience in a relevant industry.
  • Demonstrated success leading NPI teams and scaling multiple complex hardware products into high-rate production.
  • Hands-on experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and Product Data Management (PDM) software.
  • Proven track record using first-principles problem-solving to balance aggressive timelines, budgets, and resource allocation in a fast-paced environment.
  • Extremely organized and detail oriented with exceptional communication skills.
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience in maritime, naval, or aerospace defense, with knowledge of NAVSEA or MIL-SPEC standards.
  • Experience with MES and ERP systems for production and material planning: working with JIRA, Siemens NX, Teamcenter (PLM), or Oracle or equivalents.
  • Background in supply chain and/or procurement in a high-rate production environment producing large finished electromechanical goods.
  • Hands-on technical credibility having personally built, debugged, or repaired hardware in a production environment, and is comfortable being on the floor with technicians as the default operating mode.
  • Technical foundation in mechanical assembly, electrical integration, heavy metal or composite fabrication, or precision machining.
US Salary Range
$166,000—$220,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.
